title: Implement Request Logging Middleware
description: This feature adds a logging middleware to track and record all incoming requests, providing valuable insights for debugging and performance optimization. It will log request method, path, headers, and response status code. This helps identify issues and improves the overall reliability of the framework.
testCases: Test logging for requests with query parameters
acceptance: The logging middleware should log all requests and responses without affecting the framework's performance, and logs should be formatted in a readable and consistent manner
reason: Implementing request logging is a high-impact feature that improves the framework's debuggability and maintainability, allowing developers to diagnose issues more efficiently
